mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening economic activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profit margins are expected to compress.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 2 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
